q: If 3 cats catch 3 mice in 3 minutes, how many cats catch 100 mice in 100 minutes?
why: Each cat catches 1 mouse every 3 minutes, so in 100 minutes one cat catches about 33. Three cats catch 100.

q: A bat and a ball cost $1.10. The bat costs $1 more than the ball. What does the ball cost?
why: If the ball is x, the bat is x + $1. Together 2x + $1 = $1.10, so x = 5 cents. (Most people say 10.)

q: Lily pads double daily and cover a lake in 48 days. When did they cover half?
why: The patch doubles every day, so the day before it was full it was exactly half full.

q: How many months have 28 days?
why: Every month has at least 28 days. February just has nothing more.

q: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?
why: 'All but 9 run away' means 9 stay.

q: You overtake the runner in 2nd place. What place are you in now?
why: You take the place of the runner you passed. The leader is still ahead of you.

q: How many times can you subtract 10 from 100?
why: After you subtract 10 once, you have 90, not 100.

q: Divide 30 by half and add 10. What do you get?
why: Dividing by a half doubles: 30 ÷ ½ = 60. Then + 10 = 70.

q: A clock takes 5 seconds to strike 6. How long to strike 12?
why: 6 strikes have 5 gaps between them, so each gap is 1 second. 12 strikes have 11 gaps.

q: Which is bigger: 2¹⁰ or 10³?
What is 15% of 80?
why: 10% of 80 is 8, 5% is 4, together 12.

q: A shirt is $20 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
why: $20 is 80% of the original. $20 ÷ 0.8 = $25.

q: Two coins add to 30 cents. One of them is not a nickel. What are they?
why: One of them is not a nickel. The other one is.

q: A rope ladder hangs off a boat, rungs 1 foot apart, 3 rungs in water. Tide rises 2 feet. Rungs underwater?
why: The boat floats, so it rises with the tide and the ladder rises with it. Still 3 rungs under.

q: What is half of 2, plus 2?
why: Half of 2 is 1, then add 2: 1 + 2 = 3.

q: What's heavier: a kilo of feathers or a kilo of steel?
why: A kilo is a kilo. Size and material don't change the weight.

q: Next in the sequence: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
why: Fibonacci: each number is the sum of the two before it. 5 + 8 = 13.

q: Next in the sequence: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
why: Differences grow by 2: +4, +6, +8, +10, then +12. 30 + 12 = 42. (Also n × (n+1).)

q: Next in the sequence: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
why: Square numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², then 6² = 36.

q: Next in the sequence: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
why: Each number doubles. 24 × 2 = 48.

q: Next in the sequence: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, ?
why: Differences grow by 1: +1, +2, +3, +4, then +5. 11 + 5 = 16.

q: Next in the sequence: 100, 50, 25, 12.5, ?
why: Each number is half the previous one. 12.5 ÷ 2 = 6.25.

q: What letter comes next: J, F, M, A, M, J, ?
why: First letters of the months: January, February, March, April, May, June, July.

q: What letter comes next: O, T, T, F, F, S, S, ?
why: First letters of the numbers: One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight.

q: What letter comes next: M, T, W, T, F, ?
why: Days of the week: Monday to Friday, then Saturday.

q: Which number doesn't belong: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11?
why: All the others are prime numbers. 9 is 3 × 3.

q: How many birthdays does the average person have?
why: You are born once. Every other year is a birthday party, not a birth.

q: 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes. How long for 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
why: Each machine makes 1 widget in 5 minutes, so 100 machines make 100 widgets in 5 minutes.

q: February 1, 2028 is a Tuesday. What day is March 1, 2028?
why: 2028 is a leap year, so February has 29 days: 4 weeks and 1 day after Tuesday is Wednesday.

q: If yesterday was two days before Friday, what day is tomorrow?
why: Two days before Friday is Wednesday. If yesterday was Wednesday, today is Thursday and tomorrow is Friday.

q: A train leaves at 9:40 and takes 85 minutes. When does it arrive?
What is 7 × 8 − 6?
why: Multiply first: 7 × 8 = 56, then 56 − 6 = 50.
Line up the decimals: 0.9001 is just over 0.9, and 0.099 is under 0.1.

q: I'm an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What am I?
why: Remove the S and SEVEN becomes EVEN.

q: Three friends share a $30 pizza. Two of them pay $15 each. How much should the third give each of them?
why: A fair share is $10, so each payer is $5 over. The third friend gives each of them $5.

q: If a doctor gives you 3 pills and says take one every 30 minutes, how long do they last?
why: Take one now, one after 30 minutes, the last after 60 minutes. The gaps add to 1 hour.

q: What is 999 × 7?
Which weighs more: 1,000 grams or 1 kilogram?
why: 1 kilogram is exactly 1,000 grams, so they weigh the same.

q: A square has a perimeter of 36. What is its area?
why: Perimeter 36 ÷ 4 sides = 9 per side. Area 9 × 9 = 81.

q: How many seconds are in 2.5 minutes?
The day before yesterday was Monday. What is the day after tomorrow?
why: If the day before yesterday was Monday, today is Wednesday, so the day after tomorrow is Friday.

q: Dad is 4× his son's age. In 20 years he'll be 2×. How old is the son now?
why: Son s, dad 4s. In 20 years: 4s + 20 = 2(s + 20) → 2s = 20 → s = 10.

q: If it takes 8 men 10 hours to build a wall, how long for 4 men (same pace)?
why: Half the workers take twice as long.
